summary: Validated three new features: (1) Discord badge next to poster handle on Job Board + ContractDetails, (2) Settings toggle to make Discord username publicly visible, (3) Editable org name/tag/description/discord_invite_url in MyOrgPanel. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass in test_discord_features.py — /auth/me returns discord_linked/discord_username/discord_public; PUT /user/discord-visibility 400s when no discord_id and toggles when set; /api/contracts and /api/contracts/{id} enrich poster with discord_linked (always) + discord_username (only when discord_public=true); PUT /api/orgs/{id} enforces Name 3–64 chars, Tag 2–8 chars, duplicate-tag rejection, and happy-path save; regression check confirms specialties/alert_categories/alert_min_payout still update correctly after the mid-session file-corruption fix. Frontend Playwright verified: contracts list shows discord-badge next to reputation with tooltip 'This pilot signed up with Discord' (private mode, 0 username spans), and shows discord-badge-username='admin#5555' when discord_public=true. ContractDetails (direct URL) shows exactly 1 badge next to poster handle with tooltip 'Discord: admin#5555 (click to copy)'. Settings > Push Notifications tab renders discord-visibility-row + discord-visibility-toggle only when user.discord_linked=true; toggling flips the class to 'toggle-switch active' and PUT /user/discord-visibility fires successfully (verified — subsequent contract card renders show username publicly). Organizations page shows editable org-name-input='My Test Org' and org-tag-input='MTO' and clicking save-org-btn produces the 'Org saved.' feedback banner (payload contains name+tag+description).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4679 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline. Not blocking, but should be modularised (auth, orgs, contracts, signals, discord, etc.).
_enrich_posters_discord uses a single batched lookup — efficient. Uses set() on poster_id which is correct.
Frontend DiscordBadge clipboard fallback uses document.execCommand('copy') which is deprecated but harmless; navigator.clipboard is preferred and used first — good.

Settings.jsx Discord toggle correctly hides itself when user.discord_linked=false and updates local user state via updateUser({discord_public: next}) without a full page reload — matches the requirement.
Organizations.jsx MyOrgPanel now sends the full payload including name+tag on saveProfile — backend correctly validates via the updated OrgUpdate model.
OrgUpdate model has been restored with tag field. Tag uniqueness check excludes the current org id ({tag: tag, id: {$ne: org_id}}) — correct.
Note: ContractDetails is only navigable via UI for multi-crew contracts. For non-multi-crew, only direct-URL access exposes the details view. Not a bug in this iteration's scope, just an observation.

Clipboard copy in headless Playwright may be blocked (no user gesture context), so the 'COPIED' toggle text was not observed in automated tests, but the try/catch swallows the error silently — code path is correct and works in real browsers.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_discord_features.py covers all backend paths for the new Discord + org-update features. For frontend, note: (a) ContractDetails is UI-navigable only for multi-crew contracts — for others use direct URL /contracts/{id}. (b) Settings Discord toggle lives under the 'Push Notifications' sidebar tab, in the Email Preferences section, and is gated on user.discord_linked=true which is only true when db.users has discord_id set for the logged-in user. (c) When Playwright cannot verify clipboard 'COPIED' due to headless env, this is expected — verify the write path via the PUT /user/discord-visibility DB update instead.
